title: Servepath latency lens with error-class breakdown and io-mode slices
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an operational dashboard (Latency Lens) that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency across model + route combinations with two orthogonal breakdowns: IO mode (streaming vs non-streaming) and error-class buckets (client errors, model timeouts, infra retries, kv-cache-misses). The dashboard will tightly link metrics, logs, and traces to enable fast RCA: clicking a cohort should open a trace sample, show recent error logs, and the request payload distribution (seq length, batch size). Provide panels for SLO coverage, tail decomposition, and example alert rules tied to regressions vs baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for model x route matrix for last 1h/6h/24h with IO-mode toggle
Cohort selection pipes to sampled traces and a clipped log window (most recent 50 entries) via trace-id linking
Error buckets (client_4xx, model_timeout, infra_retry, kv_cache_miss) are calculated from unified telemetry and appear as stacked bars and filters
SLO panel computes daily burn rate and indicates when p95 exceeds target for >10 minutes
Example alert (p95 delta > 30% vs 24h baseline sustained 15m) is validated in staging and fires a Slack alert with trace links
Documentation page with query snippets, dashboard layout, and instrumentation checklist published
